Firefox calls could fail to connect
raw:
les(2,"Firefox calls could fail to connect",[
 ["setup","Connecting a browser call means swapping notes","Each side describes how it can be reached."],
 ["trap","Firefox sends one particular marker","On every single connection, without exception."],
 ["before","That marker crashed the code handling it","So the call never started."],
 ["now","It is handled properly","Fixed in Pipecat 1.7.0."],
 ["us","This is very likely the Firefox problem on our list","Our notes say the call setup route crashed in Firefox once before, and has not been retried. One connect settles it."]
]);

title: Early signals dropped on a slow browser
Browser audio at half speed

Why the Overall Latency chart is gone
raw:
les(3,"Why the Overall Latency chart is gone",[
 ["setup","The chart added up five per-turn timings","And only drew once all five had arrived."],
 ["before","1.8.1 stopped sending one of the five","It was a measurement that never made sense for speech-to-text that runs continuously."],
 ["trap","So the chart would have gone blank silently","Not failed loudly. Nobody would have noticed for weeks."],
 ["now","Chart, accumulator and reset all deleted","The per-service charts and the typing indicator are untouched."],
 ["us","Deploy the front end first","The front end only deletes things, so it is safe against the old back end. The other order leaves a broken chart in the playground for the gap between deploys."]
]);

title: Response time measured the same for everyone
Dates read aloud in mixed languages
The transcript did not match what was said
The pause detector got nine times smaller
Agent startup roughly halved
Connections now open in parallel
Every call left a worker behind
Spoken lines started joining the agent's memory
raw: les(5,"Spoken lines started joining the agent's memory",[ ["setup","Some lines are ours, not the model's","The greeting, the thank you while it thinks, a clarification, the sign-off."], ["before","1.8.1 made those join the reply model's memory by default","In 1.4.0 a setting appeared for it. In 1.8.1 that setting defaults to on."], ["trap","So the agent would hear itself thanking people","And be primed to keep doing it, every single turn."], ["now","We set the choice explicitly in all nine places","bot.py passes the flag at every TTSSpeakFrame: on for the greeting, off for the acknowledgement, the clarification and the sign-off."], ["us","A test guards it","test_every_tts_speak_frame_sets_append_to_context reads the source and fails if any of those nine places leaves the choice unstated."] ]);

title: The noise filter's model had to change
raw: les(5,"The noise filter's model had to change",[ ["setup","The noise filter strips background noise before we listen","Its toolkit went from 2.2.1 to 3.1."], ["before","The new toolkit cannot load the model we pinned","The error is raised during call setup, so the call never starts."], ["trap","Every call would have failed on the first deploy","Not some calls. Every one, from the first, because the failure happens while the call is being set up."], ["now","Moved to the newer model","And wrapped, so a model that will not load leaves the call running without noise removal instead of killing it."], ["us","The model id is pinned in bot.py","AIC_MODEL_ID = "quail-vf-2.2-l-16khz". The old 2.1 model publishes no version the new toolkit can load."] ]);

title: Sarvam would have jumped from v3 to v4
raw: les(5,"Sarvam would have jumped from v3 to v4",[ ["setup","Our transcription model was never named in our code","We took whatever Pipecat's default was."], ["before","1.2.1 defaulted to saaras:v3","1.8.1 defaults to saaras:v4."], ["trap","Upgrading would have changed the model on every call","Silently, with nothing in the diff to show it."], ["now","Pinned to saaras:v3","Five other providers were pinned at the same time, though none is reachable in production."], ["us","v4 may well be better","But changing transcription underneath a turn-taking upgrade makes any regression impossible to attribute. It needs its own evaluation."] ]);

raw:
les(7,"New events for saving each turn's audio",[
 ["setup","The two events we use fire once per run of speech","Several times a turn, carrying no turn number."],
 ["now","The replacements fire once per turn","And include which turn it was."],
 ["trap","The two we use are removed in Pipecat 2.0","Deprecated as of 1.8.0."],
 ["us","Our version limit protects us","We pinned Pipecat below 2.0 on purpose, for exactly this reason."],

]);
